name: Stanford Cars
description: Stanford Cars is a fine-grained image classification dataset of 16,185 car images across 196 car classes, with training and test splits.
citation: Krause, J., Stark, M., Deng, J., & Fei-Fei, L. (2013). 3D Object Representations for Fine-Grained Categorization. IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW). https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCVW.2013.77
